description: This file contains a Swift actor 'MicLevelMonitor' that manages audio input for monitoring microphone levels. It includes methods to start and stop audio monitoring, process audio buffers to compute and smooth audio levels, and update a SwiftUI view 'MicLevelBar' to visually represent microphone input levels. It relies on AVFoundation for audio processing and SwiftUI for UI components.

classes.name: MicLevelMonitor
classes.description: An actor managing real-time microphone level monitoring, starting/stopping audio engine, processing audio buffers, and sending level updates to UI.

classes.name: MicLevelBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View displaying microphone input level as a segmented bar with color coding.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Asynchronously starts audio input monitoring, initializing AVAudioEngine and installing tap on input node.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops monitoring, removes taps, and halts the audio engine.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Updates smoothed microphone level and calls the provided update callback.

methods.name: normalizedLevel
methods.description: Calculates normalized audio level (0-1) from AVAudioPCMBuffer, converting RMS to a decibel scale.

methods.name: segmentColor
methods.description: Determines color of segments in MicLevelBar based on level fraction.
